headline: Budget: primary surplus for the ten-month period reaches 7.78 billion euros - Tax revenues above forecasts
summary: Bulgaria's budget primary surplus for the first ten months reached 7.78 billion euros, with tax revenues above forecasts. The overrun against target is 1.04 billion euros after Ministry of Finance adjustments.
why: Budget balances shape fiscal policy, sovereign credit assessments and borrowing costs for Bulgaria, a euro-area member.
